profile.title: Conservative radial concentration field for the pulmonary channel case

validity.population: software grid-refinement verification against the M4.8 pulmonary-bound synthetic tracer case

validity.description: A spherically symmetric finite-volume field evolves normalized signal amount through 128 and 256 radial shells, records the complete final field, and verifies receiver response plus active-degraded-escaped balance against the analytical free-diffusion reference.

limitations: Spherical symmetry collapses the three-dimensional environment to radial shells and cannot represent directional flow, asymmetric walls, or localized tissue structures.
The absorbing outer boundary approximates an unbounded far field only because it is placed eight transmitter-receiver separations from the source and its escaped fraction is explicitly gated.
The point release is initialized as a uniform normalized amount in the innermost finite-volume shell, introducing a grid-dependent source regularization that is tested by refinement.
The receiver uses interpolated shell concentration and the same passive small-receiver approximation as the analytical channel rather than integrating an off-center sphere across shells.
The molecular parameters and geometry remain synthetic software fixtures, not physiologically qualified pulmonary data.
